mintAuthority.summary: dEURO admits arbitrary new minters through a permissionless fee/application process unless nDEPS holders veto them. Once admitted, a minter can mint durable tokens to a chosen recipient without a token-level collateral or numeric cap check; MintingHub collateral constraints do not bind arbitrary admitted minters. D14 is unbounded and unreconciled. Transferable current-state nDEPS voting and veto-only admission do not qualify as sole flash-resistant token-governor issuance.

controls.label: Frankencoin-style minting module (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by per-position overcollateralization with oracle-free auction liquidation; users self-mint against approved collateral.
controls.evidence: Verified on-chain 2026-07-20: the dEURO constructor block 22088283 approved 8 minting modules (MinterApplied events: 0x8b3c41c649b9c7085c171cbb82337889b3604618, 0x4ce0ab2fc21bd27a47a64f594fdf7654ea57dc79, 0x073493d73258c4beb6542e8dd3e1b2891c972303, 0x5c49c00f897bd970d964bfb8c3065ae65a180994, 0xd03cd3ea55e67bc61b78a0d70ee93018e2182dbe, 0x2353d16869f717bfcd22dabc0adbf4dca62c609f, 0x3ed40fa0e5c803e807ebd51355e388006f9e1fee, 0x0423f419de1c44151b6b000e2daa51859c1d5d2a); no MinterDenied events were observed through block 22,140,000, and isMinter() = true at the latest block for 0x8b3c41c6..., 0x4ce0ab2f... and 0x073493d7.... Mint is bounded per module by overcollateralized position rules; the module set is expandable through the application-and-veto process, so the aggregate cap is raiseable.

controls.label: nDEPS veto governance (Equity contract)
controls.evidence: nDEPS (Equity) at 0xc71104001a3ccda1bef1177d765831bd1bfe8ee6, deployed by the dEURO constructor in block 22088283, governs minting-module admissions: anyone may propose a module with a fee and application period; nDEPS holders can veto via denyMinter(). This governance path can authorize new minting capacity.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295200: DecentralizedEURO (0xba3f535bbcccca2a154b573ca6c5a49baae0a3ea) is immutable, no EIP-1967 proxy admin slot, owner() reverts, code length 21734. Equity/nDEPS contract (0xc71104001a3ccda1bef1177d765831bd1bfe8ee6) confirmed via internal CREATE from dEURO constructor at block 22088283. The minting model is Frankencoin-style: anyone can suggestMinter() with a fee and application period; nDEPS holders can denyMinter(). No privileged operator can mint directly; new modules are time-delayed and community-vetoable. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: permissionless overcollateralized minting can expand only through the challenge-period and nDEPS veto process, with no off-chain reserve claim or prudential supervisor. D14/D29 sweep 2026-10-03 supersedes the historical raiseable classification: at Ethereum block 26113566 (hash 0x8ee5bf8702023bb24470045b03b62f22fe10f1c46654ea9e79377e5dac7193b9), reserve() confirms Equity 0xc71104001a3ccda1bef1177d765831bd1bfe8ee6 and MIN_APPLICATION_PERIOD()=1209600 seconds. Verified suggestMinter admits any new address after fee/application requirements; mint(target,amount) checks minterOnly without a posted-collateral or amount check. Module-level collateral checks do not bind arbitrary new minters, so D14 is unbounded. D29 fails G1 because admission is permissionless unless vetoed, not affirmative token-governor execution. Equity votes use current balance multiplied by holding age; transfers adjust the recipient anchor. This is not evidence of a flash exploit, but this transferable current-state model is live-balance, not D29's lock-escrowed or past-block-checkpoint voting. The 14-day application delay does not constrain subsequent mint calls from an admitted arbitrary minter. Complete current module/position executionScope inventory is not certified; no governed qualification is authored. With reconciliation not-applicable and no supervision, fallback is unbounded-unreconciled.
